title: Worker view heap sift-up
summary: At VA 0x42ca50 the routine fills a heap hole by moving lower-priority parents downward and inserting the pointer read from the supplied value slot. Comparison is signed at item offset 0x188; equality stops movement. The internal caller passes the array in ECX, hole in EDX, top and value slot on the caller-cleaned stack, plus an unused stack word.
test_description: Compare directly with the accepted original across holes, top bounds, signed extremes, equal priorities, and value slots both separate and aliased to every array slot. Compare all array slots including guards, all item bytes, the external value slot, and the installed FS head after every original call; vary the unused argument.
known_limits: Item type, priority meaning and the wider worker-view layout are unresolved; only offset 0x188 is modeled.
The portable interface expresses the semantics rather than the original internal register convention; the test uses GCC regparm to reproduce that convention.
Valid accessible pointers and indexes are required; invalid memory behavior and integer overflow outside practical heap indexes are not modeled.
No matching machine-code claim is made.
